questions.prompt: In the JavaScript event loop, in what order do synchronous code, microtasks (Promises), and macrotasks (setTimeout) execute?
questions.explanation: Synchronous execution finishes first, then the microtask queue (Promise callbacks) drains completely before the next macrotask is dequeued.

questions.prompt: What security mechanism prevents a malicious website from executing unauthorized script requests against an authenticated API domain?
questions.explanation: CORS policy and SameSite cookie attributes protect web endpoints from unauthorized cross-origin requests and CSRF attacks.
